english: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
text: acquire confidence 写出信心逐渐建立，而不是突然宣布“我很自信”。中文“开始有信心”可以用 began to feel confident；这里选择 acquire，是把信心看成考试顺利后逐步获得的东西。
author: Codex
